items.title: Maplebear (CART) Sale Faces Fresh Fairness Scrutiny
items.summary: Multiple investor rights law firms have opened investigations into the planned sale of Maplebear (NasdaqGS:CART) to DoorDash. The probes focus on whether Maplebear shareholders are receiving fair consideration and full, accurate disclosures under federal securities laws. Law firms are reviewing potential remedies that could include higher acquisition terms or additional information for Maplebear investors before the vote.
